candidate_workaround: Inventory the exact file with a bounded fast probe, then read the unchanged file in full with a 60-second wrapper.
failure_signature: Required full skill or metadata read exceeds a short process wrapper before content returns.
recurrence_guard: Do not repeat the same short wrapper; preserve every timeout and verify EOF content before task action.
rollback: Stop the bounded probe, retain the failure, and return to the last clean repository state without external mutation.
scope_boundary: Preferred only for the declared local workflow trigger; it grants no scientific, professional, authority, production, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Bounded full skill read after short-wrapper timeout
trigger_preconditions: A required local instruction file has not yet been read to EOF and the short wrapper timed out.
